title: CmdPal: Synchronize global hotkeys with active commands

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

Reviewed active-command hotkey filtering, provider enablement, settings-notification ordering, shortcut reassignment, retained registrations and hook disposal. The production settings getter and UI scheduler did not support the hypothetical failure claims, and no actionable correctness issue remained in the assessed paths.

**Validation scope:** The exact-head x64 Release ViewModels and UI test builds passed, and all 177 selected hotkey tests passed. Interactive Command Palette workflows were not exercised.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
